svg.title: Element 115 detective board
svg.desc: Board of people, places, evidence and red flags. Lazar alleges S-4 and claims in 1989 that element 115 is stable fuel; that claim fails against reality because no stable isotope was observed and only single atoms with sub-second life exist. LLNL ships an americium-243 target to JINR Dubna, which supplies a calcium-48 beam; both feed the Phys. Rev. C 69, 021601(R) paper of 2 February 2004 and the result moscovium, Z = 115, named by IUPAC on 28 November 2016. GSI and Lund confirmed it independently in August 2013. A second thread links Banchenko, ASRP.media, the 2021 interview published in December 2025, and a LinkedIn engagement by Cardillo in April 2026.
